prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: final full-bleed 16:9 opaque background for a cozy mobile pixel-art sheep game.
Primary request: redraw this scene in the SAME coarse blocky pixel-art visual language as the farm main menu in reference Image 1.
Reference roles: Image 1 is the sole STYLE reference: use its cheerful blocky rural game illustration, square stair-step edges, grouped rounded foliage, bold readable contours, restrained simple two or three tone shading. Image 2 is only a LAYOUT / PLACE reference; DO NOT inherit its dense microtexture, tiny foliage or photorealistic rendering.
Style and detail: every visible contour is a clear square-pixel staircase, confident big pixel clusters, simple broad grouped foliage, no leaf speckles, no antialiasing or smooth painted gradients. Night scenes stay clear and pleasantly readable; use blue teal lavender meadow colors with warm amber lamps, no black overlay. Lower visual complexity than Image 2 and consistent with Image 1.
Output: exactly ONE cohesive landscape scene, one full image, horizontal 16:9, edge-to-edge opaque pixels. No atlas, grid, collage, frames, UI, written words, labels, logos or watermark.
Scene: the starlight delivery destination by a quiet sea. On the RIGHT upper background, a compact friendly FARM-STYLE IVORY LIGHTHOUSE with one muted red stripe, very simple cream block shape, an amber square lamp room and small orange-brown roof, beside a tiny orange-roof cream cottage. No realistic masonry, bricks, tiny rails, complex stonework or tall dramatic architecture. Lighthouse stands on a smooth low blue-green headland with just two broad shadow planes. Its warm beam points LEFT across the background sky only, narrow simple flat wedge above the sea and NEVER touches the road. Quiet sea in middle distance with just five or six broad horizontal blue wave bands and a few big pale-blue highlight rectangles, no tiny sparkles or foam. Distant cool blue coast at the horizon. On the LEFT above the grass rim a simple small cream mailbox on a brown post and short wood fence. Sky has 10 to 15 widely separated chunky square-pixel stars and a big simple cloud band. Gameplay composition invariant: distant horizon about 60% image height. A grass rim crosses FULL width at exactly 72% image height. An empty warm tan dirt road fills the FULL width from 72% to 96% image height; use a small bottom grass strip only below 96%. Road must be wide uninterrupted horizontal band, level, simple and quiet. Nothing on the road: no actor, object, fence, rock, flowers, mailbox, grass clumps, or branches in the road. Keep all scene objects ABOVE road, in background. Flat side-scrolling view with no perspective road into depth.
No characters anywhere. Sea/headland scene uses main menu rounded grouped foliage and gentle farm proportions.
